_note: The proven list (BUILD-SPEC B6, the maintainer's proof rule of 2026-10-16). A model is listed only when its maker's own documentation allows training on its outputs: proof_url (the maker's live page), proof_clause (quoted) and proof_date (the day it was read). role-set refuses an entry without them. A listed model is still refused until it is pinned: repo revision, GGUF file and its sha256, filled in after the download. The wave script measures the GGUF and the llama-server binary before launch and the run refuses any drift. A critic of the writer's own family is refused. Cloud tags are refused regardless.

llama_server.note: llama.cpp built with CUDA 13.4 on each host; pinned by commit and binary sha256 once built
